bundle: full_tier_entry (the ARMS01 Arm 1 bundle; 57 model columns); the enlarged menu applies to this bundle only
menu_order: anchors first in the incumbent's order, then the grid in the listed order (max_leaf_nodes ascending, min_samples_leaf descending, l2_regularization descending, learning_rate descending). Selection ties (within the existing 1e-12 tolerance) go to the earlier candidate.
fixed_grid_params_note: max_iter is not a fixed parameter for grid candidates: stopping fits use 1000 and the refit uses k_star. max_depth None: leaf-wise growth bounded by max_leaf_nodes and min_samples_leaf; realised depth recorded. max_features 1.0 (no column subsampling). sklearn internal early stopping is off; stopping is external and temporal (below). random_state has no effect with max_features 1.0 and internal early stopping off; kept at the incumbent's 71101. min_samples_leaf counts swap-augmented rows (two per match, weight 0.5 each), exactly as the incumbent.

early_stopping.stopping_validation_keys: for raw year R: the raw year's training keys (training_keys(R)) with match_date in [(R-1)-01-01, (R-1)-12-30]
early_stopping.stopping_train_keys: training keys with match_date <= (R-2)-12-30 (the product's fit-boundary convention applied to R-1)
early_stopping.keys_in_neither: training keys dated (R-2)-12-31: counted and reported; excluded from both stopping sets; included in the final refit
early_stopping.curve: L(k), k = 1..1000 (with internal early stopping off, scikit-learn 1.9.1 always completes max_iter iterations): match-weighted mean log loss, clip 1e-15, of the bag-averaged swap-symmetrised probability 0.5*(p(a,b) + 1 - p(b,a)) on the stopping-validation matches, from staged_predict_proba of each member after k iterations
early_stopping.rule: k_stop = the smallest k >= 21 such that min over j in [k-19, k] of L(j) > (min over j <= k-20 of L(j)) - tol; k_star = argmin over j <= k_stop of L(j), ties to the smallest j. If the rule never fires, k_star = argmin over j <= 1000 of L(j) and the stop status is 'cap'.
early_stopping.refit: each bag member is refit on its own subsample of the whole training window with max_iter = k_star; the stopping-fit models are never used for forecasts
early_stopping.no_row_scaling: k_star is used unchanged for the larger refit window
early_stopping.early_termination_equivalence: an implementation may stop the stopping fits at k_stop only if a test shows the identical k_star to the full-curve definition

bagging.unit: match: a drawn match contributes both swap-augmented orientations at weight 0.5; an undrawn match contributes neither
bagging.key_order: the canonical sorted key tuple (season, match_id) of the set being subsampled

roles.0: stopping fit, subsample of the stopping-train keys
roles.1: final refit, subsample of the whole training window

bagging.draw: idx = rng.choice(n_keys, size=floor(0.8 * n_keys), replace=False); idx sorted ascending
bagging.common_random_numbers: subsamples depend on raw year, role and member only, never on the candidate, so candidates are compared on identical rows
bagging.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the five members' swap-symmetrised probabilities; this mean is the candidate's raw forecast

selection: unchanged product rule (pipeline.select_calibrated_candidate): for outer year Y, each candidate's raw forecasts for raw years Y-3..Y-1 on the selection keys (cutoff (Y-1)-12-30) get one non-negative intercept-free slope fitted with equal year weight (fit_nonnegative_slope, logit clip 1e-6); the candidate with the lowest in-sample calibrated equal-year mean log loss is selected, tie tolerance 1e-12 to menu order; its slope is applied to its raw year-Y forecast. Nothing is fitted or selected on year Y.
other_bundles: base and full_tier keep the two-candidate default menu and must reproduce the ARMS01 attempt_002 forecasts byte-for-byte; the shared-base records remain well defined because both anchors are in the enlarged menu
excluded_from_menu_and_closed_by_the_fre: training windows other than five years
calibration forms other than the single non-negative slope

brief_literal_alternative.note: The orchestrator brief specified max_leaf_nodes in {15, 23, 31}. This draft adds 7 because the incumbent's own selector chose 7 leaves in 6 of 8 outer years (see TUNE01.design.md, 'Why this menu'). Dropping 7 gives 81 grid + 2 anchors = 83 candidates; everything else is unchanged.
